provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.lean.definitions.navigation against rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:read_source, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:extract_declaration, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:select, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:highlighted, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:authored_grammar_rejects_invalid_citations_and_missing_bodies, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:linked_examples_fail_on_invalid_citations_bodies_or_nesting, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:authored_theorems_select_literal_qualified_names, test:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:tests::qualified_theorem_names_match_only_the_literal_declaration_name, test:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:tests::definitions_reject_unsupported_incomplete_and_ambiguous_sources, test:mdbook-dada/tests/renderer_contracts.rs:lean_citations_accept_subdirectories_but_reject_source_root_escapes. read_source accepts relative .lean paths and omitted extensions, canonicalizes to enforce containment including symlinks, and reports missing sources. Literal declaration-name lookup deliberately does not infer namespaces. The cited tests exercise subdirectories, traversal/absolute/symlink escapes, qualified names, missing/wrong-kind targets and malformed bodies. No claim of a standalone or elaborated excerpt is made. Notation and judgment context was checked in unit:meta.sources.configuration, unit:meta.sources.exact_selection.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Implementation and test inspection does not establish universal correctness, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution. Mechanical results are retained separately.
